messages.content: What are the statistics of Ronaldo's matches in 2021?

function.name: player_statistic
function.description: Retrieves detailed player's statistics for a specific year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year for which the statistics will be displayed.

team_name.description: The name of the team(optional). Default to not use it if not specified.

We should call the function with appropriate arguments:

player_name: "Cristiano Ronaldo" presumably; year: 2021; optionally team_name could be "Manchester United"? Actually he played at Manchester United until mid-season then moved to Juventus? But we might just provide overall stats across all clubs.

But the question may also refer to "Ronaldo" as generic. We'll assume it's Cristiano Ronaldo.

Thus call function: player_statistic({"player_name":"Cristiano Ronaldo","year":2021}). No team needed.
